purpose: Transfer the strongest epistemic controls from the polyimide/siloxane investigation into System 3 without transferring its chemistry: readiness before interpretation, nested evidence promotion, independent gates, raw-record precedence, and fail-closed disagreement handling.

forbids: using H diffusion kinetics to choose electronic settings
using published site ordering as a method tiebreaker
interpreting H adsorption or barriers before the clean surface is qualified

requires: local H vibrational stability for the numerically selected minimum
forbids: forcing the published adsorption minimum onto the new calculation

requires: one unstable saddle mode aligned with the computed path
forbids: allowing a later rate comparison to rescue a failed or ambiguous reaction path
switching quantum rate theory after inspecting experimental agreement without a separately frozen amendment
treating HeSE dephasing as reaction-coordinate gamma by default

requires: domain-specific chi semantic license if chi is used
forbids: using chi to retroactively select any earlier method, path, bead count, or threshold

promotion_rules.promotion_basis: An added tier is admitted only to support an additional claim that cannot be licensed by the simpler qualified tier, and its own numerical/admissibility gates must pass prospectively.

evidence_language.rule: State only the strongest conclusion licensed by the highest readiness state actually reached.

examples.bulk_pass_only: PBE candidate passed frozen Ru bulk gates; it is not yet a qualified H/Ru surface method.
examples.surface_pass_only: Clean Ru(0001) numerical model is qualified under the frozen surface protocol; H adsorption and diffusion remain unadjudicated.
examples.classical_path_pass: Classical PES/path baseline is qualified; no full quantum rate claim follows.
examples.quantum_pass_without_dissipation: Quantum free-energy/rate tier may be compared under its registered scope; no scalar damping or chi claim follows.

causal_separation_rule.principle: Do not collapse distinct causes or evidence channels into one explanation when the design can separate them.
system3_application: bulk numerical adequacy versus surface adequacy
classical barrier versus nuclear quantum correction
dephasing versus population relaxation versus projected friction
scalar stability coordinate versus modal/subspace structure versus conglomeration/system coupling
